pitches_skipped.reason: A: No frame shows the ball settled in the glove: it passes the glove's right/lower edge between -0.07 and +0.00, drops into the dirt and rests at (622,304) from +0.17 onward while the catcher lifts an empty glove, so there is no catch frame to choose.; B: No frame shows the ball in the mitt: it passes the mitt at -0.07, is on the dirt below the mitt at 0.00, and lies on the ground at (622,306) from +0.17 to +0.40, so there is no catch frame.

A: No catch: the pitch bounced in the dirt before the plate, deflected off the catcher's shin/mitt area and rolled left to rest on the ground at (634,305); the ball is never in the glove in any frame.; B: No catch in the window: the ball is already at the mitt's right edge at -0.20 and is deflected away (horizontal motion blur at -0.13), caroms left-down and comes to rest on the dirt in front of the plate at (634,305) by +0.10. B: Every frame is post-catch: at -0.20 the ball is already sitting in the pocket of the dark mitt and the mitt is already sweeping up-left (22 px between -0.20 and -0.13, then 10, 8, 2, 0 px) - this is a framing motion, not flight.
